```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'bun'

      - name: Install Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run preflight checks
        run: bun run ci:preflight

      - name: Build donor package
        run: bun turbo run build --filter=@asym/donor

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: bun test

      - name: Notify code owners
        if: success()
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          body: |
            ✅ **CI passed** for this PR.  
            Code owners, please review the changes.  
            If you have any concerns, feel free to comment or request changes.
```
